            WHEN total_spend < 300000 THEN 'Bucket 2'

    FROM customer_spending
)
SELECT 
    spending_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bucketed
GROUP BY spending_bucket
ORDER BY spending_bucket ASC
